items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: And then I have been down there with Joe Merez on a lot of… with a lot of groups.

ctx.x: Weren't you? I mean after that. Quite some years after that. You know, the one that he has Marie Laveau and all of the…
Yes. And then I have been down there with Joe Merez on a lot of… with a lot of groups.
Other groups too. That's right. With Johnny St. Cyril, we have a lot of… Yes. Doc Suchon. And some of those groups.
